name: code_explainer
description: Explain what a code snippet does, analyze its algorithmic complexity, detect design patterns, suggest refactoring improvements, or do a security review.

action.description: explain: plain-language walkthrough. complexity: Big-O time/space analysis. patterns: detect design patterns. refactor: code quality/refactoring suggestions. security: vulnerability review.

code.description: The actual code snippet to analyze.

language.description: Programming language of the snippet, if known (e.g. 'python', 'javascript'). Only used for action='explain'.
